name: PT Indosat Tbk
summary: PT Indosat Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, provides telecommunications and digital technology services in Indonesia. It operates through three segments: Cellular; Multimedia, Internet & Data Communication; and Fixed Telecommunications. The company provides various mobile, wireless broadband, and fixed and digital telecommunications services. It also offers prepaid services, including Freedom Internet, Freedom 5G, Freedom U, Freedom Combo, Freedom Apps, Freedom Play, Nelpon Obrol Package, and eSIM; postpaid services; personal services comprising Tri Prepaid, Happy, Happy 5G, For You Pack, AlwaysOn, Nelpon Package; and international services.
